item.title: Meet the New Voice Awards Winners - The TV Festival
item.description: The New Voice Awards 2026 celebrated emerging talent across the TV industry at Curzon Soho, hosted by broadcaster Elle Osili-Wood. Winners included Netflix director Olaide Sadiq, BBC’s Simi Jolaosa and AA Dhand, alongside Fully Focused Productions, Bella Roberts and Fats Moeva — recognising the next generation of creative storytellers shaping the future of television.
